'''Glowfly''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Phosflare]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies.

==Overview==
Current Description: "A go-to source of ambient lighting for romantic confessions often sought out by humans. Glowfly finds the whole thing unbearably mushy, but sees it through most of the time anyway."

Glowfly is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A teal blue firefly with a round, glowing lantern (lower abdomen) that seems to have an electric charge. Its face and antennae are light beige, and its eyes appear perpetually closed. It has pink blush and there's a small green circle on each of its wing casings.

Glowfly's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter Form]] changes the color of its body from teal to purple.

== Evolution Trial ==
Glowfly's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Phosflare]] you need to complete the following task:

* Land 20 [[Pinball|pinballs]] in the Star Slot.

== Trivia ==
* Glowfly and its evolutions were added to the game on 7/1/2026 alongside [[Umbraveil]] and [[Hierotyrus]].
